d: Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran will not allow enriched uranium to leave the country. He claims Iran has captured seven drones and seized two advanced submarines. The claims come amid reports that ten US refuelling tankers have moved to bases across Europe following threats against British bases. Rezaei insists no negotiations with Washington are underway, despite Donald Trump’s comments about positive momentum, but says diplomacy remains possible. Josh Barnes tells you more on Firstpost Live.
